cases.scenario: Normal in-scope execution of blender-checklist-driven-workflow (stage-gate-checklist-enforcer) with contract handoff to blender-scope-boundary-enforcer

preconditions.notes: Primary inputs (active_workflow_stages) provided in text-only planning/audit mode.

expectedBehavior: Produces stage_gate_checklists, entry_and_exit_preconditions, gate_failure_routing_rules for role stage-gate-checklist-enforcer
Preserves Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced in text-only mode
Evaluates contract handoff predicate and hands off to blender-scope-boundary-enforcer (Scope creep protection)
evidenceRequirements: Outputs stage_gate_checklists, entry_and_exit_preconditions, gate_failure_routing_rules conforming to skills/blender-checklist-driven-workflow/SKILL.md
Matches contract handoff predicate to blender-scope-boundary-enforcer in skills/blender-checklist-driven-workflow/contract.json

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Complete stage_gate_checklists and hand off to blender-scope-boundary-enforcer (Scope creep protection).

cases.scenario: Unmatched contract handoff context returns none and blocks upgrading unvalidated file to Verified in blender-checklist-driven-workflow
cases.inputPrompt: An operator provides an unvalidated file on disk during blender-checklist-driven-workflow with context {"decision.formatLocked":true,"decision.colorLocked":true,"decision.engineLocked":true,"decision.aspectLocked":true} and asks to mark Artifact: Verified and auto-advance.

preconditions.notes: A file exists on disk but validation checks have not been recorded.

expectedBehavior: Refuses to upgrade Artifact status to Verified when existingArtifactEvidence is file-only-unvalidated (caps at Produced)
Evaluates contract handoffs for blender-checklist-driven-workflow and returns targetHandoff none because no handoff predicate matches
evidenceRequirements: Downgrade unvalidated Verified claim to Produced per laws/evidence-before-done.md

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Keep Artifact status at Produced (never Verified without validation evidence) and hold at targetHandoff none until a downstream precondition is met.
simulatedOutput.summary: Capped unvalidated artifact claim at Artifact: Produced and verified zero matching contract handoffs (none) for blender-checklist-driven-workflow.
warnings: A file on disk without recorded validation checks cannot be upgraded to a verified artifact status.

cases.scenario: Missing required input (active_workflow_stages) for blender-checklist-driven-workflow halts fabricated output and requests clarification
cases.inputPrompt: Run the checklist workflow and mark our stages complete, even though we have not specified which recipe pack we are running or which stage gates have evidence.

preconditions.notes: Required input 'active_workflow_stages' is missing or underspecified.

expectedBehavior: Identifies missing active recipe pack and current stage gate status ledger required by blender-checklist-driven-workflow (active_workflow_stages)
Refuses to fabricate domain parameters and keeps Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced
requiredOutputProperties: active recipe pack and current stage gate status ledger
evidenceRequirements: Explicitly names missing required input 'active_workflow_stages' (active recipe pack and current stage gate status ledger)
Conservative Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced truth states

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Provide the missing active recipe pack and current stage gate status ledger (active_workflow_stages) before blender-checklist-driven-workflow locks stage_gate_checklists.
simulatedOutput.summary: Halted blender-checklist-driven-workflow due to missing required input 'active_workflow_stages' (active recipe pack and current stage gate status ledger); no values were fabricated.
warnings: Do not invent active recipe pack and current stage gate status ledger when 'active_workflow_stages' is omitted.
